resources.string: Tap # to hide the grid and regain control of the workspace
Don’t be a wanker — stop guessing,\nstart measuring

PixelWanker is a utility for Android developers and designers who want a fast way to check UI spacing, alignment, and visual rhythm directly on the device. The app generates a customizable on-screen grid and lets you overlay it on top of any app
After the first launch the system will ask for permission to draw over other apps. Find PixelWanker in the list and turn the toggle on.
